items.title: Prevalence of red cell alloantibodies in transfusion-dependent thalassemia: a cross-sectional study from Bangladesh
items.source: Co-author · International Journal of Research in Medical Sciences, 14(3): 861–867
items.text: Prevalence and specificity of red cell alloantibodies (including Anti-E, Anti-D and Anti-Kpa) in thalassemia patients, and the case for routine antibody screening.

items.source: 38th BSM Annual Conference — Microbes in Health & Nutrition

items.label: BACHELOR THESIS · 2024
items.title: Comparative study of antibiotic resistance in pus, urine and blood isolates across age and sex groups in Dhaka City
items.text: 2,344 samples analyzed by culture, biochemical tests and Kirby-Bauer disk diffusion; Klebsiella spp. and E. coli most prevalent, with high resistance to first-line antibiotics.
